excluded: Anything beyond the fixed raw-datagram receive profile; see pinned profile source
UDP surplus/options, dynamic peer/port, fragments, routing, ARP/ICMP and socket service
UDP peer/physical capture, whole-stack or universal compiler proof

RX-PROFILE.interpretation: Explicit fixed raw-entry domain, length equality, surplus exclusion and rejection classes; not full protocol conformance.

IP-LENGTH.interpretation: IPv4 Total Length includes header and data; this raw-entry profile requires exact datagram bytes.

IP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Verify each admitted fixed IPv4 header; invalid checksum silently discards.

UDP-LENGTH.interpretation: UDP length includes eight-byte header and data; surplus beyond UDP length remains out of scope.

UDP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Discard invalid nonzero checksum; optionally discard absent checksum. This profile defaults to allowing absent checksums.

UDP-PSEUDO.interpretation: Checksum covers pseudoheader with IP addresses/protocol/UDP length plus UDP header/data. Zero means absent; FFFF validates normally.
